skillSays: Write plain sync Playwright scripts, always headless chromium, and always close the browser
Run bundled helpers like with_server.py with --help first and treat them as black boxes
Decision tree: static HTML -> read the file; dynamic app -> start the server with with_server.py, then reconnaissance-then-action
Wait for `networkidle` before inspecting the DOM of a dynamic app, take a screenshot, discover selectors, then act
Capture console logs while automating (skill's example writes them to a file)
Pick descriptive selectors: text=, role=, CSS ids

changes: Ran a separate reconnaissance script (networkidle, screenshot, list buttons and inputs) before writing selectors

Let with_server.py own the server lifecycle; found it leaks the server when the command is `cd x && python ...` (orphaned child kept the port, later runs got ERR_EMPTY_RESPONSE), so used `--directory` instead
Registered pageerror and request listeners before clicking, which showed the TypeError and zero requests in one run
Wrote A/B runs (default highlight vs explicitly clicked slot) so the cause is shown with a control
